run_train_model: run fairseq training on one or multiple GPUs using cli_main with config args
run_validate_model: run validation on specified subsets using validate to evaluate model performance
run_early_stopping: run early stopping check using should_stop_early based on validation loss and patience
run_checkpoint_save: run checkpoint saving and validation using validate_and_save with stopping conditions
run_training_epoch: run one epoch of training using train with logging and validation intervals
